name: Relaxation_1
short_caption: The robot stretches one arm straight up and wide, then brings it down in a gentle, relaxing stretch.
movement_description: Starting from neutral, the robot tilts its head slightly and raises its right arm in a slow upward and outward arc until it is fully extended overhead. The left arm moves slightly outward for balance as the robot stretches its torso upward. After a brief hold at the peak of the stretch, the robot smoothly lowers both arms back down and returns its head to a centered, neutral position.
safety_notes: The right arm extends fully upward and outward to its maximum range; ensure there are no overhead or lateral obstructions close to the robot.
